title: Bring Contributions Together into a Shared Proposal
status: New proposed complete production script under the requested series continuation; not a recovered historical approval.
continuity: L08 follows the earlier work on shared discussion, reasons, listening, constructive disagreement, preparing a first contribution, personal experience and repairing a stalled exchange. It now combines several contributions into a faithful shared proposal and summary.
boundaries: Seven independent sections of one lesson. Watch and Practice are modes, not separate courses.
The main case is fictional; S01–S04 use the baseline, S05 supplies a clearly labelled later proposal check, and S06 rehearses from that updated snapshot.
Alternative branch replies reset and never become facts on all paths.
Explicit support must retain its person, element and condition; silence does not supply consent.
No voting rule, leader authority, adopted full schedule or guaranteed result is supplied.
Thirty minutes is the activity length; at least five minutes for questions belongs inside that total.
The supplied information sheet may not answer every question; its full contents are not supplied.
Practice is private and unrecorded; model viewing does not verify speech or group agreement.
Final real audio and any later localization are separate downstream work.

sections.title: Map the Contributions before Combining Them
sections.learningOutcome: Map proposals, reasons, limits and open questions without changing their ownership or support status.

sections.title: Separate Shared Ground from Open Questions
sections.learningOutcome: Represent explicit and conditional support accurately while preserving open questions and avoiding consent inferred from silence.

sections.title: Combine Compatible Contributions
sections.learningOutcome: Construct a coherent candidate from compatible contributions while retaining time limits, task aims and unresolved dependencies.

sections.title: Explain a Trade-off against Shared Criteria
sections.learningOutcome: Explain the purpose and cost of a candidate arrangement against the same criteria without inventing outcome evidence or an agreed timetable.

sections.title: Present a Combined Proposal and Check Its Status
sections.learningOutcome: Present a combined candidate, ask a focused support check and update only the status actually supported by the authored replies.

sections.title: Rehearse a Faithful Summary and Next Step
sections.learningOutcome: Privately rehearse a bounded summary from the supplied evidence and review a separate authored model without inferring speaking, agreement or success.

sections.title: Transfer the Synthesis to a New Task
sections.learningOutcome: Transfer accurate synthesis to a new constrained task, keeping source support, practical checks and proposal status distinct.
